integrity: All displayed homotopy and integral-module statements follow from explicit subcomplex decomposition, skeleton chains, and long exact sequences. Finite modular and signed-Lefschetz checks are supplemental, not proofs for all parameter values.
scientific_limitations: The complexes use induced maximum-degree bounds, not connected-component or edge-matching constraints; r>=2 and m,n>=r+1. The wedge splitting is nonequivariant; the integral homology-module identification and balanced swap action are equivariant. No classification for arbitrary bipartite graphs or r=1. Possible unindexed equivalent prior coverage remains.
title: Mixed sphere wedges and integral symmetry of degree-bounded bipartite subsets
